title: Bound completed-child errors in the full QQ16 native decoder
body:
The complete QQ16 native decoder has a certified all-cut absolute-defect envelope of 1529, versus 818 at final fields. An actual signed-error execution reaches 841 in scratch F0, so endpoint-only estimates miss a real transient. This supplies the approximate-child stability obligation left by [PR2540](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2540), separate from [PR2603](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2603)'s exact caller-grid result.

For the unchanged 2,463-event word, independent signed propagation gives input coefficient P=240 and state-relative weighted coefficient K=2298. Under the declared completed-instruction defect and exact owned-CLEAR premises,

```
M <= 240 B / (1 - 2298 u)
all-cut error <= 551520 u B / (1 - 2298 u).
```

Thus `u <= 2^(-b-21)` suffices for error at most `B*2^-b` at every initialized cut. The norm is the maximum over owners of individual payload Hilbert norms, at every positive tensor depth. The 21-bit allowance is sufficient, not minimal or a physical component-rounding format. Native-only and cover-only envelopes are 192 and 280. No envelope is claimed to be a sharp operator norm.

There are 2,136 defect sites: 1,688 ADDs, 240 native children and 208 cover maps. Early-capture errors survive the temporal boundary. Current entries, inherited B1 errors, retention and exact control/CLEAR implementation remain separate assumptions. Borrowed restoration becomes approximate; an explicit private-accumulator defect changes 56 outputs after its own storage is cleared. No exact restoration or erasure admission is inferred from numerical closeness.

Registered standard-library CPython 3.12.7 validation passed:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-child-defect-bound
```

The suite authenticates and executes the full unchanged PR2540 verifier and twelve controls; recomputes 2,680 boundaries; matches 66,101 coefficients using a separately written reverse traversal; and checks 2,324 literal execution equalities, including state-dependent faults and the interior witness. Git-free read-only export and three real source/snapshot/typed-receipt corruptions pass. Separate AI proof/source/code review and independent optimized replay passed. No human review, proof assistant, hosted CI or selected supplier cold replay is claimed.

Canonical main and both predecessor heads were refreshed unchanged before submission; main is `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority 4. The sole picker seed `a3ee609ca651545e2522a64068f37f5b` selected complex mechanisms. The required binding baseline passed, and TASK records the change from the occupied P104 correction investigation to this named QQ16 precision-interface obligation. Complete overlap covered 798 open PRs and 1,252 Discussion records at 15:55/15:59 UTC, supplemented with 100 updated open PRs and exact source heads before submission. Its limits are explicit.

Credit the standard Hilbert-defect/feedback method in PR2096, PR2166 and PR2503; their different P104 constants are not transferred. Credit Ali Romman's QQ16 lineage, thakrarsagar's L2 work, starship-s's cut decoder and ywz65's PR2511/2512/2540 native composition. All source bytes and notices remain.
